spans.s: (I)--a son of बिन्दुमान् and सन्घा; his son was वीरव्रत. भा. V. १५. १५.
(III)--a son of कार्तवीर्यार्जुन; he had a hundred sons of whom वृष्नि was the eldest. भा. IX. २३. २७, २९; Vi. IV. ११. २१.
(IV)--a son of देवक्षत्र (देवक्षेत्र म्। प्। and वि। प्।) and father of कुरुवश (Puravasa म्। प्।) (कुमारवम्श-वि। प्।). भा. IX. २४. 5; M. ४४. ४४; Vi. IV. १२. ४२.
(VII)--an आत्रेय and a sage of the चाक्षुष epoch. Br. II. ३६. ७८; वा. ६२. ६६.
(VIII)--a son of Praheti: a राक्षस. Br.
(IX)--a son of खशा and a राक्षस. Br.
(X)--a son of Devana and father of Nandana, Puruvasu Manu, and मनुवश. Br. III. ७०. ४६; वा. ९५. ४५.
(XIII)--a राक्षस who attacked नारायण; was slain by विष्णु. M. १३५. ४९; १७८. 6, १८.

(XIV)--a mind-born son of Lord विष्णु born with कैटभ representing रजस् and तमस् qualities;
1: M. १७०. 1.
with कैटभ shook the lotus stand of ब्रह्मा in the navel of विष्णु lying in waters after interview with Rudra; then ब्रह्मा appealed to विष्णु in fear; भू, Bhuva and Suva entered ब्रह्मा; विष्नु and जिष्णु fought with Madhu Kaitabha when ब्रह्मा acted as arbitrator; the battle con- tinued for thousands of years; ब्रह्मा entered into con- templation when Mohini or विष्णुमाय appeared to the great grief of the Asuras; both were killed when ब्रह्मा asked for permission to create four kinds of creatures; with [page२-611+ ३७] a view to this he performed austerities when he was filled with rage and tears out of which came wind, bile and kapha besides poisonous serpents; ब्रह्मा's grief knew no bounds, and he swooned and lost his life; when Rudra appeared in eleven forms out of his face, revived him and helped him in his creation as his son.
2: वा. २५. ३०-80.
(XVII)--a son of लान्गली, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. २००.
(XVIII)--a son of वृष; had a hundred sons of whom वृष्णि was the eldest. Vi. IV. ११. २६-7, २९.

--a tribe whose Lord was कृष्ण;
1: भा.
--the १४ s4aktis attached to वासन्त cakra. Br. IV. ३२. ५३.

--the middle one of the १०१ sons of विश्वामित्र;
1: भा. IX. १६. २९; Vi.

. ३८.
invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर;
2: भा. X. ७४. 9; वा. ९१. ९६.
a sage;
3: Br. II. ३२. ११७; III. ६६. ६८.
a कौशिक Brahmis2t2ha.
4: M. १४५. ११२.
--fit for gift during विशोकद्वादशि व्रतम्। M. ८२. १९.
--a king; among the Angas after Nandana, he succeeded. His brother was नन्दियशस्. वा. ९९. ३६९.
--a wedding present of Indra to कामेश्- vara. Br. IV. १५. २२. [page२-613+ २७]
--a mythical tree in Uttarakuru yielding clothes, jewels, etc. Br. II. १५. ७२; वा. ४५. १२.
--to be recited in a श्राद्ध. M. १७. ३९.
--a Mt. west of the शितोद. वा. ३६. २८.
--a son of घृत Pr2s2t2ha. भा. V. २०. २१.

--the region of Asura Madhu and his son लवण;
1: Br. III. ६३. १८६; वा. ८८. १८५.
sacred to Hari on the bank of the यमुना; here अम्बरीष offered prayers to Hari by अभिषेक according to महाभिषेक विधि: Here शत्रुघ्न killed लवण and founded the city of मधुरा.
2: भा.
--the fifteen शक्तिस् attached to वासन्त cakra. Br. IV. ३२. ४९-53.
--a queen of Vasanta ऋतु. Br. IV. ३२. २३, ४६.
--(Madhuvana s.v.); the forest of Madhu; reference to the city of मथुरा on the यमुना; the place where Dhruva performed तपस्; was visited by Hari to see Dhruva. भा. I. १०. २६;
--a Janapada of the केतुमाला continent. वा. ४४. १४.

--a son of पुष्पार्ण and प्रभा;
1: भा. IV. १३. १३.
a वाजिन्।
2: वा. ६१. २५.
(I)--the eighteenth kalpa; the beginning of मध्यम स्वर। वा. २१. ३८.
(II)--a name of a svara sacred to Dhaivata. Va. २१. ३९.
--the middle scale in music; consists of शार्ङ्गि, पावनि and दृष्टाक--२० different kinds in it. वा. ८६. ३८, ४९.
--the middle path consisting of आर्ष- भि, गोवीथि and जारद्गवि। Br.

(II)--१२ to १८ na1likas;
1: वा. ५०. ९९; ५६. ४६.
when the sun passes three मुहूर्तस् from सङ्गव।
2: Ib. ५०. १७२.
--a R. from the lake जया. M. १२१. ७१.

(II)--the month sacred to Aryaman;
1: भा. XII. ११. ३४.
(Tamil वैकाशि); with the month of Madhu forms a ऋतु।
2: Br. II. १३. 9; वा. ५२. 5.
--an Apsarasa sent by Indra to destroy विष्णु's तपस्। M. ६१. २२.
--a tribe deriving its name from Madhu. भा. IX. २३. ३०.
--a queen of Vasanta ऋतु। Br. IV. ३२. २३, ४६. [page२-683+ २३]
(III)--a R. in the Kuru country. Br. II. १८. ७३.
(VI)--a R. from the जया lake. वा. ४७. ७१.
--a स्तोत्र in praise of कृष्ण. M. २४८. ५८.
